name: Multi-Chain Networks & Cross-Chain Infrastructure
description: Architecture of EVM chains, Layer 2 networks, Solana/SVM, Alt-VMs (Move, WASM, TVM), cross-chain bridges, CCIP/IBC interoperability, and modular data availability networks.

subskills.name: EVM Network Architecture (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC)
subskills.description: EVM architecture, chain IDs, gas token mechanics, JSON-RPC specifications, and differences across EVM-compatible L1s and sidechains.

subskills.name: Testnets, Faucets & RPC Node Providers
subskills.description: Operating on public testnets (Sepolia, Holesky), managing RPC rate limits, private RPC endpoints (Infura, Alchemy, QuickNode), and fallback providers.

subskills.name: Block Explorers & Network Telemetry
subskills.description: Navigating and querying block explorers (Etherscan, Blockscout, Solscan), contract verification, internal transaction tracing, and validator telemetry.

subskills.name: Layer 2 Rollups Ecosystem (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base)
subskills.description: Rollup architectures: Arbitrum Nitro, OP Stack (Optimism, Base), sequencer role, L1 batch submission, and L1-L2 message passing.

subskills.name: Solana Sealevel Runtime & Account Architecture
subskills.description: Solana runtime architecture: parallel execution (Sealevel), Gulf Stream mempool-less forwarding, Turbine block propagation, and Program Derived Addresses (PDAs).

subskills.name: Cross-Chain Bridges & Relayer Security
subskills.description: Lock-and-mint, burn-and-mint, liquidity pool bridges, relayer incentive networks, and bridge security threat models.

subskills.name: Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocols (CCIP, IBC)
subskills.description: Standardized cross-chain communication protocols: Chainlink Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP), Cosmos Inter-Blockchain Communication (IBC), and cross-chain token transfers.

subskills.name: Alt-VM Ecosystems (Move, TVM, CosmWasm)
subskills.description: Non-EVM smart contract platforms: Move VM (Aptos, Sui), TON Virtual Machine (TVM), and CosmWasm/Near WASM runtimes.

subskills.name: Modular Blockchain Architecture & Data Availability
subskills.description: Decoupling execution, settlement, consensus, and data availability; sovereign rollups; and Data Availability (DA) layers (Celestia, EigenDA, Avail).

github.signal: Multi-network deployment scripts and RPC configuration matrices
Solana Anchor program configurations and SVM account deserialization
Chainlink CCIP cross-chain token transfer scripts, IBC configs, and Move/WASM modules

cv.signal: Deployed multi-chain smart contracts across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, and Solana
Architected cross-chain token transfers with Chainlink CCIP and integrated modular DA layers with Celestia

linkedin.signal: Endorsements in Multi-Chain Architecture, Layer 2 Solutions, Solana Development, and Cross-Chain Protocols

assessment.signal: Passes comprehensive multi-chain networks assessment covering OP Stack rollups, Solana Sealevel, CCIP cross-chain messaging, and Celestia modular DA

junior.description: Configures RPC providers for EVM networks, uses testnet faucets, and inspects transactions on block explorers.

mid.description: Deploys onto OP Stack/Arbitrum rollups, builds programs on Solana runtime, and configures bridge relay mechanisms.

senior.description: Architects cross-chain messaging with CCIP/IBC, develops on Move/Alt-VM platforms, and designs modular Celestia/EigenDA stacks.
